Hey clippers! Night Shift Gaming wants short clips of our Friday streams.

We'll pay you two dollars and fifty cents for every thousand views your clip gets once it has passed
five thousand views, and we stop paying a single clip after it earns two hundred and fifty dollars.
Post them wherever short vertical video lives on Meta's apps or on the ByteDance one.
Every clip has to have subtitles baked into the video and has to credit the streamer in the caption.
Please keep it friendly: nothing hateful, no gambling content, and don't put words in people's mouths.
Use the tags nightshift and nsgclips. This runs until the end of November 2026.
